items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: tell Manny that I'll be interested in a valve trombone

ctx.x: And so I said to Cliff, "Look, I think I'd like a valve trombone." He was working downtown at the time at Ryan's and I said, "If you're anywhere near Manny's" -- Manny's is a music shop downtown where all the guys get their instruments and accessories and et cetera -- "tell Manny that I'll be interested in a valve trombone."
